headline: HSBC Initiates Coverage on NSE and BSE, Prefers BSE Over NSE
summary: HSBC initiated coverage on Indian stock exchanges, assigning a target price of ₹4,500 to BSE with 20% upside and a target of ₹2,300 to NSE, citing stronger medium-term earnings potential for BSE.
why: Initiation of brokerage coverage with specific price targets and ratings influences institutional investor allocation toward exchange operators.

impacts.name: BSE Ltd
impacts.why: Favorable brokerage initiation and high target prices attract institutional buying interest.
